experiment: E4 fixed-pool matched-count and serialized-byte comparison

arms.natural: Unchanged sealed risk thresholds; no quota thinning. B3 natural diagnostic keeps 95% by seed; B4 binary voxel duplicate and B5 self residual calibrated on office0; report ties and no discrimination.
arms.rank_only: Retrospective fixed-pool resource diagnostic: remove highest cumulative causal score, stable seeded ties; unknown scores never ranked as evidence. Insufficient finite candidates means unreachable. B8 scores come from its NATURAL policy-specific causal replay, not a hypothetical quota-conditioned online policy.
arms.policy_fallback: Primary: preserve all natural rejections, then apply the SAME fixed random candidate priority (seed 0) to survivors until exact K. If natural survivors<K, mark unreachable; never resurrect rejected candidates. B1 and B3 are direct count controls. Fallback rejects are logged separately; not pure admission or causal quota replay.

voxel: side=0.01 * median development predicted candidate radius, fixed before test; at each actual snapshot recompute cells using current estimated poses; birth duplicates include older map and earlier same-birth representatives; score=1 duplicate else0, with stable candidate order
calibration: Reuse E3c D_shared/D_maskmedian/P2 thresholds and E3b B2/B6/B7/B8 thresholds without retuning. B4/B5/P1_creation/P3 AND get office0-only cumulative-max subgroup 99% calibration, common cohort fixed to P2 ever-finite. P3 is min(plane/t_plane, RGB/t_rgb), unknown if either unavailable. All parameters fixed before office1 GT or held-out RGB inspection.
rgb: Original degree-0 appearance, same source-normalized RGB+SH residual, GT-aligned fixed estimated poses. Reference RGB uses exact resize/crop and gain anchored to FIRST INPUT frame only, no prediction fitting. Full-image PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS AlexNet; black background. Odd frames are unseen by tracker, not independent off-axis views; off-axis reference unavailable and not fabricated.

geometry.reference: GT-even-depth TSDF surface on exactly the same fusion views; observed-region reference, not full-scene GT mesh
geometry.distance: Deterministic triangle-area uniform samples; nearest sampled-surface accuracy/completion distances, symmetric mean Chamfer=(accuracy+completion)/2, precision/completion ratio/F1 at 5cm; fixed masks and fusion poses for all

serialization: Uncompressed float32 means[3], covariance upper triangle[6], DC RGB[3], opacity[1], exactly 52 bytes per resident Gaussian; metadata and membership index bytes separate. Physical compact CUDA buffers, not active masks. SH degree0 identical. Count and parameter bytes exactly matched in each quota arm; packed serialized maps retained.
cost: Measure actual compact map CUDA allocated bytes and peak renderer allocated/reserved memory, synchronized render median/p95 with 2 warmups and 5 repetitions on frame501. CPU score extraction/calibration/replay and GPU render/LPIPS/CPU TSDF costs separately. No cost-matched or online SLAM speed claim; tracker baseline unchanged, refiner steps=0.
